# Session 20 Research

- Session 20 requires an explicit release owner, a complete acceptance
  matrix, requirement-to-test coverage, repeated secret scanning, and
  auditable release artifacts.
- Overnight benchmark and Ubuntu/WSL qualification require customer-owned
  infrastructure and cannot be fabricated in a source-only environment.
- The package flow already emits checksums, SBOM metadata, and optional
  detached signatures.
